reviews.review: I'm just going to throw in a possitive one here, I think with time and care this game could be a staple for me, the only big issue is that preformance. But looking past it, I don't really have any complaints yet, maybe end game sucks, but hey I say try it out with an open mind.

It started fine, pulled people with Waifus but it went worse and worse. I mean ofcourse, its made under Tencent what did we expect?

And now after i reopened it to see if smth changed look at that: They re-released Aurora WITH SAME ANIMATIONS SAME  WEAPON AND SAME SKILLS as a NEW Rogueteer?!?!??
1:1 re-release

I dont know what they were thinking. Back then with issues where people got the wrong character on selection and 0 compensation, forcing people to spend money to still get that character/skin and worse.
SUPER SLOW BORING PROGRESS... waaaaaaaaaaay to easy.. you probably need 200 hours before the challenge starts

Honest review from my perspective:

1- The game is not bad at all in terms of gameplay and visuals. But, and thats a big BUT.. Gets repetitive very quickly and more content and diversity is not added. I must have a total of 20+ hours from different accounts, most of it played after launch, and the remaining recently. As mentioned before, it got boring and i uninstalled it. A few bugs here and there, too complex and unecessary mechanics didnt helped either. Still, a little thumbs up on the base idea and visuals, i want to make this positive % of feedback clear.

2- Now the most important of all, and yes i know this is my personal tastes and my opinion might not be shared by everyone when i say: The BIGGEST turn off for me is the cosmetics. I love having a cool skin, acessories etc when i play a game. Which lets face it, also makes devs happy by having profit...

But, and not just a big BUT, this is a astronomic HUGE one lol the ingame shop is basically a bunch of random and ngl kinda unecessary ingame consumables you buy with real money. Or a VERY small variety of "skins" if we can call a different color from default character base skin a "skin" itself. Then we arrive to the reason i gave a second try on this game, and uninstalled it again:

Last year by summer time some sort of event with seasonal themed summer skins came to Terminull Brigade. Which i find SUPER cool, and was all forward to support the game and spend my money on it. But the ONLY way to obtaining those skins were thru a weird (and kinda shady/gambling) method where you buy draws/rolls and if not magically getting enough "points" to claim the skin you want after spending 50+ bucks, you cant get a guaranteed skin roll after like 100+ bucks...

Now summer arrived again, and i was hopeful the devs added new cosmetics, in a normal way of buying those from the store with acessible prices. Instead when i logged in, i got presented with a ingame shop where the EXACT same skin of last year were on sale with a 50% discount from 100+ bucks to ONLY 50-60

No other major online game that have microtransactions have a single skin selling by that price. And even they had, they can do it! Their player base is big enough to know someone is going to spend that absurd amount in 1 single cosmetic that gives you zero ingame advantage. That real money value gives you literally no ingame advatages, consumables or anything besides 1 only cosmetic skin for 1 character. This game is barely abandoned on my eyes, both by players and devs. Matchmaking takes hours, player count is unstable and low and their method to attract players is selling the ONLY cosmetic in game that aint a different color of the default skins for 100 bucks on discount? Well.. Thank you but no.. This approch towards the player seems to represent imho how the game itself will be in future and i dont like what i see.

Again i started by complementing the minor, yet important aspects i liked. Just wanted to leave a explicit and personal point of view on how i dont like this game and uninstalled it twice.
((Fyi my store prices are on EUR so those values mentioned dont escape the reality of USD/EUR, it's a close rounded estimate of conversion for both currencies))
You know it's bad when even Rule 34 artists don't want to touch it

Honestly, just find a different game. There are dozens exactly like this one that have devs that ACTUALLY pay attention to their entire server base. If you're in the American servers, chances are you can't play the majority of the game cuz the devs refuse to fix the issues this newest season caused, including not being able to play the base storyline and unlock important mechanics and seasonal rewards. There's no sense giving yourself a stroke over this game, Pew Pew only cares about their Chinese servers.
I enjoyed the game as a way to get in some quick violence every now and then, but I think it's dead...
